description: Scapulothoracic shoulder after Seth et al. 2019: geometry of the published OpenSim model registered into this package's frames. scripts/fit_scapulothoracic.py derives every value from the published archive.

source.citation: Seth A, Dong M, Matias R, Delp SL. Muscle contributions to upper-extremity movement and work from a musculoskeletal model of the human shoulder. Front Neurorobot 13:90, 2019
source.archive: SimTK project thoracoscapular (https://simtk.org/projects/thoracoscapular), release FrontiersPubMaterials, ThoracoscapularShoulderPaperMaterials.zip; model Model/ThoracoscapularShoulderModel.osim (generic), IK results Results/IK/*_IK.mot

conventions: Lengths in m. Seth's clavicle, scapula and humerus frames equal this package's (same meshes, same frames). Thorax-frame values are given in chest_r: Seth's thorax point + shift_seth_thorax_to_chest_r, so that the sternoclavicular centres coincide. Quaternions w x y z. The left side mirrors z.

rhythm.description: Scapulohumeral rhythm along Seth's 18 measured motions (assembled IK, every 3rd frame), ISB angles (Wu et al. 2005, J Biomech 38:981-992) in myoarm_r, against bone-pin and radiographic literature. Positive = the named direction. Per trial the raising-phase frame nearest to each humerothoracic elevation bin (deg) and the frame of highest elevation; median and range over trials. The clavicle's axial angle is taken from Ludewig 2009 in the replay, so its rows check consistency only.

IJ.definition: incisura jugularis: Seth's marker ij (skin), in chest_r by the sternoclavicular shift

C7.definition: spinous process of C7: Seth's marker c7 (skin), in chest_r by the sternoclavicular shift

PX.definition: processus xiphoideus: Seth's marker px (skin), in chest_r by the sternoclavicular shift

T8.definition: spinous process of T8: Seth's marker t8 (skin), in chest_r by the sternoclavicular shift

SC.definition: sternoclavicular joint centre (clavicle_r origin; Seth's marker sc)

AC.definition: acromioclavicular joint centre (Seth's AC constraint point, centre of acromioclavicular_r)

AA.definition: angulus acromialis: scapula mesh vertex nearest to Seth's marker aa (12.2 mm)

TS.definition: trigonum spinae: scapula mesh vertex nearest to Seth's marker ts (15.4 mm)

AI.definition: angulus inferior: scapula mesh vertex nearest to Seth's marker ai (8.4 mm)

GH.definition: glenohumeral rotation centre (humerus_r origin; Seth's marker gu)

EL.definition: lateral epicondyle: humerus mesh vertex nearest to Seth's marker EpL (2.9 mm)

EM.definition: medial epicondyle: humerus mesh vertex nearest to Seth's marker EpM (2.3 mm)

CX.definition: point 10 mm from SC along the ISB clavicle X axis at the rest posture (qpos0), fixed on the clavicle
